Use this workbook to request comparable quotations from China suppliers for Hikaya Unique Bookshop in Kenya.
Several quantities in the source list say 'units/packs' or do not say whether quantity is total or per design. Confirm with suppliers before paying.
Compare landed cost, not unit price alone: product cost + packaging + inland transport in China + international freight + insurance + duties/taxes/clearance in Kenya.
Ask whether the supplier or sourcing agent can deliver orders from multiple factories to one warehouse for consolidated shipping.
Order samples for key products before placing a medium wholesale order, especially bags, lunch boxes, bottles, toys, markers, and notebooks.
For children's toys/art supplies and food-contact lunch boxes/bottles, request applicable product-safety or food-contact documentation. Verify independently where practical.

Prioritize lightweight, non-fragile products with broad appeal (pens, pencils, notebooks, stickers, pencil cases, bookmarks, gift sets). Treat bulky organizers and low-margin items as lower priority until freight is quoted.
Prices are intended to be entered in USD for easy supplier comparison; record the exchange rate and Kenyan landed costs separately if needed.
Fill in supplier details and prices. Filter the Product Checklist by Category or Priority. Use the Supplier Comparison sheet to compare companies.
